items.evidence: Re-measured on a fresh production build. Full sweep `perf_1080 --prod --match-seeds 7,11,23`: GATE PASS, exit 0 (fw_CW1_r3y_perf1.log/.json). Memory step +0.3 %, menus 730, 728, 729, 732 MB, tracked materials 23->23, tracked geometries 29->29, every match settled at 248-249 materials in 11-17 s. `--prod --no-build --mem-only` 3 times: +0.0 %, -0.9 %, +0.0 %, all PASS, exit 0, every match settled (fw_CW1_r3y_mem1, mem2, mem3 .log/.json). menu_2 read 730-740 MB across the 4 runs, against 679-712 MB before, and the 5 % gate and menu_2 baseline are unchanged (perf_1080.mjs:113, :602, :609). The first read at menu_5 was within 1 % of the kept read in all 4 runs, so the two-read rule did not decide any of them; the 784 MB outlier the engineer saw did not recur. Control: `--mem-only --mem-inject-mb 16` gives +5.1 %, GATE FAIL, exit 1 (fw_CW1_r3y_inject.log; engineer read +5.6 %). Triangle gate: seeds 7/11/23 peak 465k / 454k / 444k, 0 frames over 500k, 0 programs first seen after 1:00 (fw_CW1_r3y_perf1.log:60,92,116). Seed 11 ended at 1754.9 s again, so the old 518k game was still not replayed; src/render is unchanged since verify 2 (git diff c70e23634 HEAD empty for it), so the probe_crowd_arrival PASS from that round stands. overlay_regress --q high,low PASS, exit 0 (fw_CW1_r3y_overlay2.log, overlay5.log); value_probe exit 0 with no FAIL line (fw_CW1_r3y_value.log); typecheck no errors; content:check 0 warnings. Home memory: peak 1442 MB against the 2500 MB budget.

The timing halves still read 'not measured: machine busy': load 4.3-5.3 and heavy slot 2 held by pid 59283 `sleep 7200 power-hold-4` (fw_CW1_r3y_perf1.log:4,6,8,10,13). Raw numbers under that load: High 60.1, Low 60.1, Ultra 60 fps, 0 dropped frames. The holder is not this lane's, so it was left alone.

items.evidence: Two limits of the gate as now written, neither changes today's result. A match that never settles sets settled:false in the timeline without adding a miss, and the same goes for menu reads that never agree within the 8 allowed (perf_1080.mjs:~590-610); all runs here settled. The gate only just catches the control: 16 MB per cycle over 3 cycles is 48 MB injected, 39 MB seen, +5.1 %, so a leak much under about 16 MB per cycle would pass.
